title: Predict and correct
description:
Move the local player straight away, then fix the position when the server answers.

```
client predicts inputs 1..5 -> x = 5
server confirms input 3 at x = 2.5 (a wall slowed it)
client replays inputs 4..5 from 2.5 -> x = 4.5
```
hints: `while (!m_pending.empty() && m_pending.front().seq <= lastSeq) m_pending.pop_front();` then replay what is left (lesson 6.04).
If the replayed position is very close to the old predicted one, the player will not notice the correction.
requirements: The client keeps every input it sent and not yet confirmed, with its sequence number.
On a server state for input n: set the position to the server's, drop inputs up to n, replay the rest.
Use the same `move(state, input)` function on both sides.
stretch: Smooth large corrections over a few frames instead of jumping.
